analysis.one_line_summary: A curly-haired creator straightens her 3C curls using the Wavytalk Steambrush Pro to check her true hair length.
analysis.full_description: A creator with voluminous 3C curly hair performs an ASMR-style demo straightening her hair to measure its length. She showcases the Wavytalk Steambrush Pro, fills its water reservoir with a dropper, applies heat protectant products, sections her hair, and glides the steaming brush comb smoothly through the dense curls, effortlessly transforming them into sleek, pin-straight, glossy dark hair. The video ends with a back-view reveal of her silky straightened hair extending down her back.

on_screen_text.text: straightening my 3c curls to check how long it actually is

scenes.visual: Creator standing in front of camera with hair half-straightened and half-curly in a top knot, brushing it out into a huge voluminous afro-puff.
scenes.action: Creator shakes out and brushes her big voluminous 3C curls.

scenes.visual: Creator displays the pink Wavytalk Steambrush Pro, taps on the water chamber, fills it using a water dropper, and clicks it shut.
scenes.action: Demonstrating the steam water reservoir filling process with ASMR clicks.

scenes.visual: Creator takes down hair, presents heat protectant sprays and styling cream, applying them into her curly hair strands.
scenes.action: Prepping curly hair with protective hair products.

scenes.visual: Creator takes a section of curly hair and glides the heated steam brush comb through it, instantly turning it pin-straight with visible steam vapor.
scenes.action: Gliding the steam straightener brush through curly hair in single passes.

scenes.visual: Creator sections the remaining dense curls and puts on a heat-resistant styling glove.
scenes.action: Preparing another curly section and putting on styling glove.

scenes.visual: Creator clips away hair and straightens the front crown and bangs section using the steam brush, pulling down smoothly.
scenes.action: Straightening front sections and bangs with precision.

scenes.visual: Creator admiring the sleek results from the front, then turning around with her back to camera to reveal long, silky, straight hair.
scenes.action: Showing the full back reveal of straightened, shiny hair.

hook.first_frame: Creator facing camera showing a split look: half straight, half huge 3C curly hair with text overlay.
hook.visual_0_3s: Fast cuts of her brushing out her voluminous 3C curls followed immediately by the pink steam straightener.
hook.text_0_3s: straightening my 3c curls to check how long it actually is
hook.pattern_interrupt: Dramatic contrast between ultra-curly voluminous 3C texture and sleek straightened strand in the very first frame.

narrative_beats: Curiosity hook: checking length of 3C curls
ASMR tool prep and water reservoir filling
Final transformation reveal showing sleek length from front and back
key_claims: Straightens dense 3C curls into bone-straight hair
Steam infusion keeps hair smooth and shiny
pain_points: Severe curl shrinkage hiding true length
Difficulty straightening coarse 3C curls with standard flat irons
objections_handled: Handles very dense, frizzy, curly hair types effortlessly in single passes without snagging

talent.hair_before: Dark brown / black 3C tight voluminous curls with significant shrinkage
talent.hair_after: Ultra-sleek, long, straight, glossy dark hair reaching mid-back

audio_and_edit.music_description: Crisp ASMR sound effects of hair brushing, tapping plastic, water filling, clicking, and steam release, with subtle atmospheric background music.
audio_and_edit.ending: Creator turns her back to the camera, showcasing the full glossy length of her straightened hair.

analysis.notes: Classic ASMR length-check format for curl transformation. Highly engaging for tight curls / shrinkage pain points.
